The '''Gigor system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Tynquay sector/Legends|Tynquay sector]]. The system contained the planet [[Gigor/Legends|Gigor]], the homeworld of the [[Gigoran/Legends|Gigorans]].
